purpose: Release-attachable archive of binary screenshots, projects, and receipts referenced by the v3 frozen-result index. It is intentionally not committed as an ignored validation/results directory.
collection_rule: When status becomes verified, provide the local ZIP and a clean extraction directory to the gate. The gate verifies bundle SHA-256 then every index member SHA-256 before accepting its receipt binding.
publication_rule: Attach this exact ZIP to the unsigned 2.55 GitHub release; source history contains only this manifest and the curated member index.
